packageRules.description: Runtime dependencies of the library keep version RANGES (the global pep621 rangeStrategy=pin is for dev/optional deps only): dotseal is a library, and exact pins in [project.dependencies] force version conflicts onto every consumer. update-lockfile bumps uv.lock for in-range releases and only touches the range when an update falls outside it.
ruff and ty: allow pre-release versioning so updates are never suppressed. The global 7-day minimumReleaseAge still applies.
